title: Reflection Telemetry Event Schemas
description: JSON schema definitions for reflection pipeline telemetry events: candidate extraction, approval, and rejection.

run_id.description: Source run that produced this candidate.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for the reflection candidate.

pattern_type.description: Type of pattern detected (procedural, diagnostic, etc.).

pattern_id.description: Optional persisted TraceAnalysisService pattern identifier linked to this candidate.

source_trace_ids.description: Canonical trace identifiers used to join this candidate back to observability records.

extraction_job_id.description: Optional trace-analysis extraction job responsible for this candidate.

execution_observability.description: Optional execution correlation metadata used to project this telemetry into canonical observability records.

source_trace_ids.description: Canonical source traces attached from candidate provenance.

execution_observability.description: Optional execution correlation metadata inherited from candidate provenance.

rejection_reason.description: Reason supplied when the candidate was rejected.

source_trace_ids.description: Canonical source traces attached from candidate provenance.

execution_observability.description: Optional execution correlation metadata inherited from candidate provenance.
